## The claim

P4-6: every catalogue-free lane places the confirmed BUB1B pair in the top decile of the callset's biallelic pairs.

**Prediction if true.** For each of alphamissense, esm1b and spliceai, the confirmed pair's percentile in results.it4_model_ranks is at most 10.00 %.

**What would refute it.** Any catalogue-free lane places the confirmed pair below the median (percentile above 50 %) — reported as that lane's blind spot. A lane with no opinion on the pair is neither support nor refutation.

## History

| Rev | Status | Confidence | Reasoning |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | proposed | — | — |
| 2 | testing | 0.20 | Not supported and not refuted by its own terms, recorded as such rather than rounded. Two of the three catalogue-free lanes have no opinion on the pair — the claim's refutation clause says that is neither — because each scored the missense half and cannot score a stop_gained allele, and rank.py excludes a pair with an unscored half rather than scoring it zero. The one lane that ranks it, SpliceAI, puts it at the 23.63rd percentile: outside the predicted top decile, above the refuting median. The claim was aimed at the wrong unit: every missense lane places the pair's missense allele in its top 2.6 % and AlphaMissense in its top 0.47 %, so as a claim about alleles it would be supported three times over. As a claim about pairs it cannot be settled by a roster in which three of four lanes are missense-only and the pair is half nonsense — the lane gap entry 114 predicted from consequence classes and entry 119 confirmed by coverage. The revision it is owed is a lane that scores a nonsense allele (GPN-MSA). Entry 129. |
